text: In your destination particularly, they are in truth half your business: for, if you once gain the affections as well as the esteem of the prince or minister of the court to which you are sent, I will answer for it, that will effectually do the business of the court that sent you; otherwise it is up-hill work.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter LVI, to his son, London, November 18, Old Style 1748
